author: RamSet
releaseNotes: 0.19.14 - Engine update (shared hapCore 0.10.16) that matters if your thermostat ever goes offline (power loss, WiFi drop, or a reboot). Before, a gone thermostat made the driver retry the FULL network discovery every ~60 seconds forever — enough to spike your hub's load and make the admin UI sluggish. Now those retries back off automatically (1m, 2m, 5m…) and the expensive whole-network scan is throttled to at most once every 30 minutes, so an offline thermostat stays quiet on the hub. When it comes back, it reconnects within a few minutes — even if the ecobee rebooted onto a new HomeKit port (the driver now re-checks the port instead of hammering the old one). Also: the healthStatus attribute now flips to 'offline' within about a minute of a real outage (was up to ~30 min), so your alerts fire promptly. No settings to change. (0.19.13 held one stable session via TCP keepalive; 0.19.12 fixed the healthStatus attribute.)
